Product names

Source: R/scenario.R
product_output_names.Rd

Names each product after its own name, falling back to a positional name (product_1, product_2, ...) for unnamed products. These match the share_* columns returned by run_scenario().

Usage

product_output_names(products)

Arguments

products

A competitive_set, a single product, or a list of products.

Value

A character vector with one name per product, in order. NONE is not included.

Examples

cjt <- conjoint_df(example_utilities, example_crosswalk)
flagship <- product(
  cjt,
  c("Northwind", "$299", "20 hours", "256 GB", "Black"),
  name = "Flagship"
)
budget <- product(cjt, c("Cascade", "$199", "10 hours", "128 GB", "Blue"))

product_output_names(flagship)
#> [1] "Flagship"
product_output_names(list(flagship, budget))
#> [1] "Flagship"  "product_2"
product_output_names(competitive_set(flagship, budget))
#> [1] "Flagship"  "product_2"
